mapper.sql: select a.id, a.apply_no, a.student_no, a.name, a.gender, a.phone, a.college, a.major, a.class_name, a.grade, a.cohort, a.dept_id, a.skills, a.intro, a.obey_adjust, a.photo_url, a.card_url, a.status, a.audit_user_id, a.audit_user_name, a.audit_time, a.audit_remark, a.retry_count, a.member_id, a.ip, a.create_time, a.update_time, d.dept_name as dept_name from oa_member_apply a left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = a.dept_id
mapper.select: where a.student_no = #{studentNo} and a.status = '0' order by a.id asc for update
where a.phone = #{phone} order by a.create_time desc, a.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into oa_member_apply ( apply_no, student_no, name, gender, phone, college, major, class_name, grade, cohort, dept_id, skills, intro, obey_adjust, photo_url, card_url, status, retry_count, ip, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{applyNo}, #{studentNo}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{college}, #{major}, #{className}, #{grade}, #{cohort}, #{deptId}, #{skills}, #{intro}, #{obeyAdjust}, #{photoUrl}, #{cardUrl}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{ip}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update oa_member_apply set status = '1', member_id = #{memberId}, audit_user_id = #{auditUserId}, audit_user_name = #{auditUserName}, audit_time = sysdate(), audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and status = '0'

update oa_member_apply set status = #{status}, audit_user_id = #{auditUserId}, audit_user_name = #{auditUserName}, audit_time = sysdate(), audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and status = '0'

update oa_member_apply set name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, phone = #{phone}, college = #{college}, major = #{major}, class_name = #{className}, grade = #{grade}, cohort = #{cohort}, skills = #{skills}, intro = #{intro}, obey_adjust = #{obeyAdjust}, photo_url = #{photoUrl}, card_url = #{cardUrl}, status = '0', retry_count = retry_count + 1, audit_user_id = null, audit_user_name = '', audit_time = null, audit_remark = '', update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and status = '2'
update oa_member_apply set status = '3', update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and status = '0'
mapper.select: select max(apply_no) from oa_member_apply where apply_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
